versions.changelog:
- Updated installation instructions in SKILL.md for improved clarity and ordering (pip install step now first).
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- No changes to functionality or requirements.

- Added pip-based installation instructions and pip as an install method for the aitun dependency.
- Updated installation instructions to include `pip install aitun` as a cross-platform option.
- Removed the sample skill-card.md file.

- Added Windows PowerShell installation instructions for aitun in the setup section.
- No other content was changed.

- Updated installation verification instructions: now recommends using only which aitun instead of which aitun || pip show aitun.
- No other functional or content changes.

- Updated installation instructions to recommend installing aitun via the official install script (`curl -fsSL https://aitun.cc/install.sh | bash`) instead of pip.
- Clarified CLI reference section to match new install method.

- Added version field to SKILL.md and updated CLI reference for clearer TCP-only usage.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- Improved documentation for the aitun CLI, especially regarding the use of `--tcp-ports` and TCP-only mode.
Initial release - real-time collaboration via aitun tunnel
